level_reasons: Break My Fix finding 1: an input that breaks mqtt_exporter.main._normalize_name_in_topic_msg

issue.title: Doesn't support Shelly 3EM format very well

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the bug and the fix guards it with no regressions found, but Break My Fix found a counterexample: _normalize_name_in_topic_msg(topic='shellies/shelly/emeter/0/power', payload='123.45') returns ('shellies/shelly', {'power': '123.45'}), dropping the emeter index so the three phases are still not distinguished. Look next at how the Shelly emeter/<n>/<metric> topic is normaliz…

property.name: emeter_phases_differentiated
property.claim: Two Shelly 3EM messages from the same device differing only in the emeter phase index must normalize to different topics, so the phases can be differentiated
property.quote: there's no way to either sum, or differentiate the three phases' measurements

findings.relation: the same before the fix, but the failing call runs the fix's line(s) 172, 173, 174, 182, 183: the fix touched this path and left it broken
